glosses: to kick the ball hard and long, as a way of defending or inapt playmaking

examples.text: Ich konnte den Ball im letzten Moment noch aus dem Strafraum pöhlen.
examples.translation: At the last moment, I was able to kick the ball out of the box.
examples.english: At the last moment, I was able to kick the ball out of the box.

glosses: to play football, especially on a small ground in a residential area (Bolzplatz)

examples.text: Wir gehen pöhlen. Kommst du mit?
examples.translation: We’re going to play some footy. Are you coming along?
examples.english: We’re going to play some footy. Are you coming along?
